task_definition.task_description: Check the current time in New York and the NYSE market status, then retrieve my savings account balance sheet. Please archive that balance sheet as a high-priority "Q1 Financial Summary" via email, perform a text analysis on that title, and finally publish the Apple market window for me.

user_input.query: Hi there, could you please check the current time for the America/New_York timezone and let me know the current market status for the NYSE? After that, I need you to retrieve the balance sheet for my savings account linked to user_id user_1234. Please archive this document as a high-priority email under the title Q1 Financial Summary, and then perform a text analysis on that Q1 Financial Summary title. Lastly, please publish the market window for the ticker AAPL using the window_id win_99 for me. Thanks!
